messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: Pager fired: routing latency SLO breach in us-west-2. p95 -> 480ms (baseline 120ms), p99 -> 2.4s. Streaming stalls observed (~9% streams with >5s stall). Auto-notify to #incidents and oncall. Link: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/abcd/router-latency

alice.sre: I'm seeing a big spike in router tail. Admission logs show misrouted shards to a small subset of shards in us-west-2. Looks like a policy rollout changed weight seeds around 09:12 UTC.

ben.platform: Confirming — routing-policy-rollout job completed ~09:10 and updated zone-affinity weights. Could be a bad seed distribution causing hot partitions.

carla-eng: Logs: 
```
2026-03-15T09:13:02Z router-usw2-01 INFO route_assign shard=shard-17 weight=0.95 target=shard-17
2026-03-15T09:13:02Z router-usw2-02 INFO route_assign shard=shard-17 weight=0.94 target=shard-17
2026-03-15T09:13:02Z router-usw2-09 WARN queue_wait_ms=1200 inflight=42
```
Hotshard concentration on shard-17 and neighbors.

dave-oncall: taking pager. Starting triage: collecting profiles + top keys. Adding `route_debug` tag to recent requests. @alice.sre can you pull KV cache hit rates by shard?

alice.sre: KV cache hit drops for shard-17: from 86% -> 12% after rollout. Suggesting many new cold prefixes hit that shard.

erica-pm: Customer-impact check: CS reports elevated API errors for streaming sessions in us-west-2. No full outages yet, but a few higher-tier customers reported stalls. Notifying AE immediately. @customer-success-bot please post templated customer note.

customer-success-bot: Draft to customers: "We are investigating increased API latency for live streaming in us-west-2. Engineering is actively mitigating. We'll update in 30 minutes." (sent to affected accounts)

ben.platform: Hypothesis: policy rollout introduced weight skew combined with sticky routing causing hot partitioning. Two-pronged mitigation: 1) rollback policy rollout; 2) increase spread by lowering per-shard affinity threshold. Which is safer for live traffic?

carla-eng: Rollback path ready: `svc-deploy routing-policy --rollback 2026-03-15-0910`. Rollback should restore previous weight distribution within ~30s. If rollback doesn't fully rebalance, we can trigger a soft re-shard (slow).

dave-oncall: I'll run rollback now. Marking incident status: INVESTIGATING -> MITIGATING.

incidents-bot: Action taken: routing-policy rollback initiated by dave-oncall at 09:22 UTC.

alice.sre: After rollback start: p95 down to 260ms, p99 to 1.1s. KV cache hit for shard-17 climbing back to 70% after prefix affinity decays. Streaming stall rate down to ~3.5%.

carla-eng: Still seeing a small subset of routers with elevated queue_wait_ms (600-900ms). Running `curl` to drain a few overloaded instances from LB. Command: `kubectl exec -n router router-usw2-09 -- /bin/sh -c "echo draining > /proc/self/evict"`

dave-oncall: Drained router-usw2-09, 2 instances replaced. Observed immediate tail improvement on that host.

ben.platform: Can we add a quick safety check to stop automatic policy rollouts until we add a canary that validates skew metrics? I'd rather block this from recurring.

carla-eng: Agreed. Adding rollout gating: require max-per-shard-weight-change < 0.2 and shard-hotness entropy test. I'll open an infra PR and coordinate canary job.

erica-pm: Customer update: "Mitigation in progress; rollback applied; most users see improved latency. We'll follow up with root cause and preventative steps." Sent.

alice.sre: Triage notes saved to postmortem draft. Root cause: policy rollout produced skewed weight seeds + sticky session behavior causing hot partitioning; secondary cause: insufficient canary gating for per-shard skew.

dave-oncall: Handing to ben.platform for post-incident work + rollout gating. I'm going back to page rotation. If anyone sees p99 > 1.5s after 10m, re-page me.

ben.platform: Taking lead. Thanks @dave-oncall. Action items: 1) PR for rollout gating (carla), 2) add live metric check to deployment pipeline (alice), 3) postmortem + customer RCA (erica). Targeting full writeup in 48h.

incidents-bot: Incident status -> RESOLVED (partial): latency improved, customer impact mitigated. Please file postmortem when complete.

carla-eng: Quick follow-ups: dump of router assignments attached in artifacts bucket: s3://redwood-incident-2801122334/assignments.log

alice.sre: Final metrics at close: p95=130ms, p99=180ms, streaming stalls <0.5%. Closing monitoring loop.

customer-success-bot: Final customer note posted. No major escalations. AEs briefed.

ben.platform: Closing thread. Good on-call handoff, nice coordinated rollback and drain. We'll iterate on gating to avoid weight skew regressions. :thumbsup:
